questions.q: What happens to a Lookup child record when the record it looks up to is deleted?
options: The entire object is deleted
The child record is unaffected and simply keeps its lookup field blank
Salesforce blocks the deletion of the parent
The child record is deleted too
questions.explain: Lookup is a loose reference: deleting the looked-up record does not delete the record that referenced it.

questions.q: Under a Master-Detail relationship, what happens to detail records when the master record is deleted?
options: Nothing — they are unaffected
They are converted into master records
They are deleted along with the master
They are archived automatically
questions.explain: Master-Detail is a tight bond: deleting the master deletes every detail record with it.

questions.q: Which relationship type does a Roll-Up Summary field require on the child object?
options: Master-Detail Relationship
External Lookup Relationship
Hierarchical Relationship
Lookup Relationship
questions.explain: Only Master-Detail gives Salesforce the structural guarantee needed to maintain a live aggregate, so Roll-Up Summary fields require it.

questions.q: What does an optional Lookup Filter do?
options: It converts a Lookup into a Master-Detail relationship
It deletes records that don't match a condition
It hides the related list from page layouts
It narrows which records a user is allowed to pick as a valid choice in the lookup field
questions.explain: A Lookup Filter is a condition that restricts which records appear as valid choices, without touching any existing data.

questions.q: In Schema Builder, how can you tell a Lookup field from a Master-Detail field on the same object card?
options: Only Master-Detail fields appear on the card at all
The connecting line style differs and the field itself is labeled with its relationship type
Lookup fields are shown in red text
You can't — they look identical
questions.explain: Schema Builder draws a Lookup line differently from a Master-Detail line, and labels each field with its relationship type right on the object card.
